en: Old black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy bridge and street scene with a prominent church tower featuring an onion-shaped dome. Pedestrians and a tram marked with the number 68 cross a richly decorated iron bridge with ornate lampposts. Behind the bridge stand multi‑story buildings with shop signs in German. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the scene, and the publisher's imprint appears along the lower edge.
